messages.text: I want to launch the spring campaign next week, with the new order-history page ready first.
I read the content plan and the order-history spec. I can plan five tasks: voice check, post copy, the page, its review, and the publish. Nothing runs until you approve the plan.
Approve it, but I want to approve the post text myself.
Understood. The publish task stops at its gate: you will see the exact text and its hash before anything is sent.
Planned: one task for the engineering agent. It will ask which settings are public.
